source_precedence: canonical registries and live governance records
department SSOT and local governance rules

analysis_intake.rule: Preserve the complete submitted artifact literally before review, normalization, classification, promotion, or execution.

global_induction_queue.rule: Every new induction must be queued here before it is treated as active governed program work.

induction_registry.rule: Every new induction must have a canonical entry here and a matching live queue record before it can be treated as governed active work.

lifecycle_reconstruction.name: FIRST_CONTACT_PRESERVATION
lifecycle_reconstruction.observed_rule: Submission is captured or preserved in Analysis Intake before review or normalization.
lifecycle_reconstruction.record: source path, hash, size, capture mode, preservation status

lifecycle_reconstruction.name: INTAKE_CLASSIFICATION
lifecycle_reconstruction.observed_rule: Intake records review status, promotion status, provenance, and limitations separately from preservation.
lifecycle_reconstruction.record: intake queue entry and preserved capture

lifecycle_reconstruction.name: GLOBAL_QUEUE_REGISTRATION
lifecycle_reconstruction.observed_rule: A new induction must have a live global queue record before active governed work.

lifecycle_reconstruction.name: CANONICAL_INDUCTION_RECORD
lifecycle_reconstruction.observed_rule: The induction registry must contain a matching canonical entry and linked queue entry.

lifecycle_reconstruction.name: LEXICON_GAP_ROUTING
lifecycle_reconstruction.observed_rule: New terms enter the gap queue and move through resolution lanes with claim and provenance checks.

lifecycle_reconstruction.name: VALIDATION_OR_PROMOTION
lifecycle_reconstruction.observed_rule: Validation evidence and claim gates govern later canonical vocabulary or program use.

lifecycle_reconstruction.name: ANALYSIS_PROJECTION
lifecycle_reconstruction.observed_rule: Analysis and generated projections are downstream read-only views and do not confer authority.

authority_role_matrix.authority: operational projection and decision support; registry remains canonical

preservation_guarantee_analysis.guarantee_as_written: Strong: complete artifact preservation/capture, source hash, source path, capture mode, and immutable capture status are required before induction.
preservation_guarantee_analysis.finding: Preservation is explicitly separated from review and promotion; preserved records survive HOLD_C1 and NOT_REVIEWED states.

induction_review_coupling_analysis.observed_rule: Review summaries, classifications, or HOLD_C1 dispositions do not substitute for preservation.
induction_review_coupling_analysis.coupling: Review is downstream of preservation, but induction activation also requires live queue and canonical registry linkage.
induction_review_coupling_analysis.finding: The policy prevents review from erasing first contact, but current records show a synchronization boundary between intake, global queue, and canonical registry.

projection_completeness_analysis.exact_name_crosscheck: Not a valid completeness proof because aliases, derived terms, and resolution mappings are allowed.
projection_completeness_analysis.observed_mismatch: Many queue terms do not exact-match canonical term names or the alias map; a complete mapping manifest is not evident in the audited source set.
projection_completeness_analysis.finding: Generated/canonical projections cannot be certified complete from name matching alone; omission detection requires an explicit queue-to-canonical/alias mapping and reconciliation result.

failure_path_analysis.rejection: Lifecycle enum includes rejected, but no rejected live queue records were observed in the current 56-entry queue; excluded_frozen is used for 3 records.
failure_path_analysis.deferral: HOLD_C1 and queued/not-reviewed records preserve source and prevent promotion; deferral is visible as status rather than deletion.
failure_path_analysis.supersession: Superseded/historical handling is governed elsewhere, but no complete induction-specific supersession ledger was identified in this audit scope.
failure_path_analysis.failed_review: PARTIAL and NOT_REVIEWED states are represented; explicit failed-review terminal behavior is not visible in the live queue schema.
failure_path_analysis.missing_linkage: Four queued global entries lack a linked registry entry; one induction registry entry has no matching queue ID.
failure_path_analysis.db_staleness: The DB runtime reports stale snapshot state, so DB-derived authority conclusions are bounded and registry evidence controls this audit.

baseline_findings.statement: First-contact preservation is explicitly governed and evidenced by hashes and immutable capture states.
The intended lifecycle requires intake preservation, global queue registration, and canonical induction linkage before active governed work.
Current queue/registry reconciliation is incomplete: four global queue entries lack registry linkage and one registry entry lacks a matching queue record.
Review and promotion are recorded separately from preservation, but explicit failed-review and supersession survival semantics are not fully visible in the induction queue schema.
Projection completeness is not demonstrable without an explicit mapping manifest; exact term-name comparison is insufficient because aliases and derived shorthand are allowed.
The governance DB runtime is stale relative to the worktree, so DB output cannot be treated as a fresh baseline authority projection.
